name: Lemma Telepath
tagline: Your existing Telegram conversations, readable by Cline.
description:
Telepath connects your own Telegram account to Cline over a hosted MCP server. Not another channel for talking to an assistant through Telegram — it gives Cline the conversations you already have.

- **Search** your whole archive: messages, captions and voice transcripts.
- **Read** what people sent you — PDFs, spreadsheets, documents, photos — by content, not just by filename.
- **Reply, edit and react as yourself**, when you leave that capability on.
- **Notes**: a small markdown store scoped to your account.

It runs on Telegram's official business-bot API — a bot you add to your own account under Settings → My Account → Chat automation, which is open to every account and needs no Telegram Premium. There is no MTProto user session; nothing logs in as you.

Sign-in is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration: authorization opens in your browser, you log in with Telegram, and no API key is involved. You choose which chats the bot may see, and every capability is a switch you control from the bot itself.

The service is hosted and **not end-to-end encrypted** — to search and transcribe for you, our servers process your messages. Each account gets a physically separate database, the disk is encrypted at rest, and `/deletedata` erases everything we hold. The full picture is on our [privacy page](https://telepath.lemma.company/privacy).

install.notes: Authorization opens in your browser — sign in with Telegram, no API key needed. First add @lemma_telepath_bot in Telegram under Settings → My Account → Chat automation and pick which chats it may access.
